text:
Marta (PM): Quick sync — customer asks for more granular token/billing fields + a stable trace id format for debugging multi-hop requests. Can we scope a minimal, opt-in schema for hosted and a verbose telemetry for Dedicated/Private?

Devin (Eng): +1. We need a minimal payload that doesn't explode logs. propose: `token_usage.{input,output,context,cached}` and `billing_tokens.{charged}` for billing-only downstream.

Simon (ML): Heads-up: model-level token attribution can be noisy with KV cache and debounce. We should include both raw counts and an estimated billed count. Eg: `raw_input_tokens`, `raw_output_tokens`, `billed_tokens`.

Anya (Data): For analytics we also want `prompt_hash` (opt-in) and `embedding_version` when embeddings are returned. Those help linking eval sets without capturing full text.

Keisha (CS): Customer ask: stable `trace_id` so they can correlate with app logs. They want a human-readable prefix to easily grep.

Devin (Eng): Proposed trace format: `ri:{env}:{YYYYMMDD}:{short-id}` e.g. `ri:prod:20260320:7f9a2b`. Short, monotonic date for retention partitioning. Keep full UUID in internal index if needed.

Marta (PM): Good. Also needs a privacy opt-out flag and opt-in header for expanded telemetry. We can't enable expanded by default for hosted.

Devin (Eng): Agreed. Proposed opt-in header: `X-Redwood-Telemetry: expanded=true` OR `expanded=pii-off` for lower detail. 

Simon (ML): For function/tool calling we should attach `function_token_breakdown` when present. Minimal example: `function_calls: [{name, input_tokens, output_tokens}]`.

Keisha (CS): Can we show a sample response schema here to unblock docs?

Marta (PM): Draft sample (minimal, opt-in verbose telemetry):

```
{
  "request_id": "r-9a8b7c",
  "trace_id": "ri:prod:20260320:7f9a2b",
  "model": "redwood-13b-ft",
  "token_usage": {
    "input": 18,
    "output": 54,
    "context": 72,
    "cached": 5
  },
  "billed_tokens": 67,
  "function_calls": [
    {"name": "lookup_user", "input_tokens": 12, "output_tokens": 8}
  ],
  "response": {"text": "..."}
}
```

Anya (Data): Suggest adding `prompt_fingerprint` under opt-in telemetry, hashed server-side, to join across requests without storing text.

Devin (Eng): Implementation notes: 1) field naming: prefer `token_usage` (clear) over `billing_tokens` for user-facing telemetry. Billing shim will compute `billed_tokens` server-side. 2) keep the telemetry object optional in response unless header set.

Keisha (CS): Launch criteria checklist from CS POV: docs + example SDK unpack, opt-in header supported, privacy FAQ, sample log correlation, and a simple rollback plan.

Marta (PM): Product/Launch checklist (first pass):
- API contract PR merged (schema + examples)
- SDKs: node/python helpers to parse token_usage and trace_id
- Console: telemetry toggle per org (hosted) + retention defaults
- Docs + migration guide for customers
- Canary rollout to 5% orgs, monitor cost/regressions
- Customer comms: opt-in steps and data retention

Simon (ML): Also add eval gate: unit tests that ensure token counts don't regress >3% for a sample prompt set when quant/ops change.

Devin (Eng): Security/PII: `X-Redwood-Telemetry=expanded` must be audited and only scoped to org admins. For Dedicated/Private we can expose more internal flags but with KMS/HSM controls.

Keisha (CS): Customer question: will embeddings include token counts per embedding? They want per-embedding metadata.

Anya (Data): Add `embedding.meta.tokens` and `embedding.meta.model_version` (opt-in). Keep vector payload separate to avoid coupling.

Marta (PM): Decisions to capture now:
- naming: `token_usage` as primary object, `billed_tokens` as a top-level billed estimate
- trace format: `ri:{env}:{YYYYMMDD}:{shortid}` (human-friendly) + internal UUID index
- telemetry opt-in via `X-Redwood-Telemetry` header; default = minimal/none for hosted
- function call breakouts returned under `function_calls` array with token counts
- embeddings expose `embedding.meta.*` opt-in fields only

Devin (Eng): Action items:
- @Devin: draft API PR with json-schema + examples (due EOD Fri)
- @Simon: add token regression tests to inference-suite (due next Wed)
- @Anya: define analytics join keys and hashing spec (due Tue)
- @Keisha: draft customer FAQ and canary comms (due Thu)

Keisha (CS): :thumbsup: I'll start a one-pager for customers and include enterprise options for full telemetry in Dedicated.

ops-bot: Deployment note: canary rollout flagged for `api-v2-telemetry` at 5% starting 2026-03-25 00:00 UTC.

Marta (PM): Thanks team — we'll reconvene after the PR lands. If anyone objects to the naming choices speak now or I'll lock by EOD.
